notes: One fixed three-stock NYSE universe; selection was made before this run, but current survivors are not a point-in-time NYSE universe.
Existing SMA strategy defaults; no threshold, asset or horizon sweep.
Daily close signals execute no earlier than the following session open; no shorting or leverage.
Forty-three bps charged separately on each entry and exit notional; participation is a conservative sizing proxy based only on prior-session volume, not a verified opening-auction fill.
Two-ATR stop uses the prior completed session; gap-through stops fill at the worse open. No intraday take profit or trailing ambiguity.
Two-percent drawdown latch is observed at session close and exits at the following open; gaps can exceed two percent. No re-arm in a block.
Dividends accrue as a non-spendable receivable on ex-date for shares already held; actual payment dates and taxes are not modeled. Reject split-bearing samples.
Each chronological block starts with fresh diagnostic capital and full prior warm-up; none is claimed to be prospectively untouched.
Close remaining positions at the final close of each diagnostic block, with exit costs, solely for terminal accounting.
